verdict.rationale: Mercury documents AI bill reading that auto-populates bill details and remembers recipients so bills can be approved and paid (mercury-docs-3). It also documents approval-policy routing for payments (mercury-docs-55, mercury-docs-47, mercury-docs-53) and transaction categorization with accounting-sync AI automations (mercury-docs-12, mercury-docs-6, mercury-docs-29). Matching invoices to purchase orders is not evidenced at all, and automatic GL coding of bills is only implied. missing for 10: purchase-order matching, explicit automatic coding of vendor bills, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI bill-pay flow.
